newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Edenor approves $300 mln bond program.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Edenor approves $300 mln bond program.

text.p: Argentine power utility Edenor SA said Tuesday it has approved a $300 million negotiable bond program.
The company said in a staement to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange it has got the go ahead for the program from the Comision Nacional de Valores, the local financial markets watchdog.
Edenor added that it is seeking authorization from the Stock Exchange to list the bonds when they are issued.
No information was given of the maturities or other details of the planned issues.
